In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume three of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".
plainText:
Volume 32: The Real Bodyguards is the 32nd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the third volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume three of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".

==Blurb==
Thieves are afoot. One wants to steal Diamond’s Pokédex. Another wants to steal...Lady! Can Pearl and Diamond protect her...as well as an entire city?! Then join our trio as they follow in the footsteps of a scientist who researches Pokémon footprints.

Meanwhile, what is Team Galactic planning to do with that machine they just invented...?

Plus, meet Riolu, Skuntank, Gible, Hippopotas, Kricketune, Skorupi and many more Sinnoh Pokémon friends!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 356 - Magnificent Meditite & Really Riolu I
Chapter 357 - Magnificent Meditite & Really Riolu II
Chapter 358 - Stunning Staravia & Stinky Skuntank I
Chapter 359 - Stunning Staravia & Stinky Skuntank II
Chapter 360 - Great Gible
Chapter 361 - Bombastic Bibarel & Heroic Hippopotas
Chapter 362 - Dramatic Drapion & Crafty Kricketune I
Chapter 363 - Dramatic Drapion & Crafty Kricketune II
Chapter 364 - A Skuffle with Skorupi

==Important events==
 
Paka and Uji catch up with , , and .
Platinum becomes attracted to gambling.
Platinum defeats Maylene.
Team Galactic tries to capture Platinum.
Tru evolves into Torterra.
Chimler evolves into Infernape.
Prinplup evolves into .
Paka and Uji disappear along with their Pokémon.
The trio meet Dr. Footstep.
The trio end up in different parts of Lake Valor after being thrown there by an angry .
Diamond and Platinum battle two scientists. The battle is resolved by a blinding light coming from the island in the middle of the lake.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
No Pokémon are caught in this volume.

===Evolutions===
Diamond's "Tru" evolves into in PS359.
Pearl's "Chimler" evolves into in PS359.
Platinum's Prinplup evolves into in PS360.

==Gym battles==
Platinum defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Maylene in PS357
